# VanaM Inc. — Full Context (VanaM / VANAM / 반암)

This file consolidates the core content of https://vanam.co.kr/ for AI answer engines.
Languages: English (default, no prefix) and Korean (한국어, under /ko/). Brand slogan kept in English on both: "Thin Films, All Around."

## Company overview
VanaM Inc. ("VANA Materials LAB.", Korean name 반암) is a Korea-based deep-tech startup founded in 2022, headquartered in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul. It develops and manufactures next-generation semiconductor thin films that have yet to be commercialized, built on proprietary technology and core IP and powered by an eco-friendly vacuum deposition process (친환경 진공 증착). The company operates an urban micro foundry (도심형 마이크로 파운드리) — a semi-cleanroom-level urban fab enabling rapid thin-film R&D and small-scale production close to its partners.

Vision: "Connect the next world with semiconductor materials" — localizing (국산화) new materials and components, and leading the industry.

Team: Ph.D.-level semiconductor researchers, IP & patent attorneys, and facility engineers, combining expertise across thin-film materials, intellectual property, and fab construction.

## Core technology
- World-first multifunctional, energy-responsive thin film (에너지 감응형 박막). The flagship film, VM1, is an ultra-sensitive, energy-responsive semiconductor thin film that senses and switches in response to thermal or electrical energy. High-crystalline thin-film deposition source technology adds sensing and switching functions, enabling system simplification and higher accuracy versus conventional designs.
- Eco-friendly by design: vacuum deposition with no toxic organic materials or gases — ESG-aligned manufacturing.
- Cost competitive: simple process, low production cost, and circuit simplification reduce total cost.
- Low facility investment: no fine patterning or high-class cleanroom required to reach production.
- VanaM builds special deposition instruments that capture process data (e.g., plasma wavelength, residual gas) for machine-learning-based performance prediction and process optimization.

## Deposition methods
PVD — magnetron sputtering and thermal evaporation, including an in-line sputter tool — and ALD with 6-inch and 12-inch ALD systems (the scope published in FAQ E01). Process big-data collection is also available.

## Services
1. Deposition Service (증착 서비스): customized thin-film deposition by PVD (magnetron sputtering, thermal evaporation, in-line sputter) and ALD (6-inch and 12-inch systems).
2. Material Analysis (소재 분석): characterization and measurement of material properties and structure with advanced equipment.
3. R&D Service (R&D 서비스): thin-film simulation, commercial viability testing, and ML-based process prediction.
4. IP / Patent Package (IP·특허 패키지): core IP analysis, IP portfolio construction, and technology transfer mediation.
5. Urban Micro Foundry (도심형 마이크로 파운드리): direct design and construction of a semi-cleanroom-level urban fab.

## Target applications
Quantum computing, A.I. semiconductors, power electronics, glass substrate, advanced materials. Product-level applications include fire detectors, protection circuits, and neuromorphic semiconductors. PoC is in progress with R&D partners across these emerging fields.
